welcome: Welcome to the Movement Meadow! Pick an animal, then move with me.
frog-intro: Frog hop! Squat low, then spring up with a big ribbit!
bear-intro: Bear crawl! Hands and feet down. Crawl slowly and give me a roar!
crab-intro: Crab walk! Sit down, lift your tummy, and step sideways. Click click!
bunny-intro: Bunny bounce! Crouch down, then bounce up softly.
penguin-intro: Penguin waddle! Stand tall and rock side to side with tiny steps.
flamingo-intro: Flamingo balance! Stand tall, lift one foot, and stretch your wings.
reward: Amazing animal moves! You earned a paw stamp!
parade-intro: Animal parade! Three animals are marching with you.
parade-next: Great move! Here comes the next animal.
parade-complete: Wild and wonderful! Your animal parade is complete!
pause: Let's take a pause. Tap play when your body is ready.
choose-again: Choose another animal, or start a parade.
